title: Keep keyboard focus clear
summary: Focus is the place that will receive the next key action.
introduction: Focus is the place that will receive the next key action. Your task: Use only the keyboard to move between both buttons.
learningObjectives: Use only the keyboard to move between both buttons.
Explain the example for keep keyboard focus clear

blocks.text: Focus is the place that will receive the next key action. A visible outline shows that place to someone using a keyboard.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.
Read the code step by step

items: `:focus-visible` selects a control when the browser decides its focus should be shown, commonly during keyboard use.
`outline` draws a visible line around the control. In a value such as `3px solid navy`, the parts mean thickness, line style and colour.
`outline-offset` leaves space between the control edge and its outline, so the focus mark is easier to see.

blocks.text: Using Tab moves a visible focus outline between the buttons.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Avoid outline: none unless you provide another equally clear focus mark.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Use only the keyboard to move between both buttons.
